title: Corporate VPN Gateway Connectivity Failure
keywords: vpn network remote access connectivity authentication gateway anyconnect tunnel timeout
content: Users experiencing inability to establish or maintain secure VPN connections through enterprise VPN concentrators or edge gateways. Symptoms include handshake timeout, certificate errors, or intermittent disconnection.
troubleshooting_steps: Verify the health and active session capacity on the primary and secondary VPN concentrators.
Check RADIUS and MFA authentication server reachability and response latency from the VPN appliance.
Inspect edge firewall logs for blocked IPsec/SSL traffic on ports 443 and 500/4500.
Confirm if client certificates or AnyConnect client software versions are expired or outdated.
If more than 20 users are impacted, check ISP uplink status and failover to secondary BGP line.

title: Office Wi-Fi and Local Network Packet Loss
keywords: wifi wireless lan packet loss latency dhcp dns access point slow connection switch
content: Users in corporate office buildings report intermittent connectivity, high latency, inability to acquire IP addresses via DHCP, or local DNS resolution failures.
troubleshooting_steps: Check DHCP scope utilization on the local domain controller to ensure address pool is not exhausted.
Examine wireless controller for rogue access point interference or overloaded radio channels.
Verify uplink interface errors or CRC discards on the core distribution switch.
Perform ping and traceroute tests to gateway and external DNS (8.8.8.8, 1.1.1.1) to pinpoint loss hop.
Review access point logs for firmware crashes or authentication timeouts with 802.1x RADIUS.

title: Active Directory Account Lockout and Password Reset
keywords: password reset login account locked badpwdcount authentication active directory sso identity
content: Single user or batch of users unable to authenticate against domain controllers or cloud identity provider due to account lockout, expired passwords, or invalid reset tokens.
troubleshooting_steps: Inspect Active Directory event log ID 4740 on the PDC emulator to identify the calling source IP/workstation.
Check for persistent cached credentials on mobile devices or mapped network drives generating repeated bad logon attempts.
Verify user identity using the out-of-band verification protocol (manager approval or verified callback).
Unlock the user account and generate a temporary one-time password with mandatory change upon first logon.
Confirm cloud sync status (Azure AD Connect / Entra ID) if the user accesses hybrid cloud apps.

title: Role-Based Access Control and Permission Denied Errors
keywords: permission access denied unauthorized 403 rbac security group shared folder privileges
content: Users receive HTTP 403 Forbidden or file system 'Access Denied' errors when attempting to access shared folders, internal portals, or SaaS applications.
troubleshooting_steps: Verify the exact resource path, URL, or application security group required for the user's job role.
Check the user's effective group memberships in Active Directory or Okta/Entra ID.
Confirm if group nesting is causing delayed Kerberos token updates (user may need logoff/logon to refresh token).
Inspect NTFS file share ACLs or application role assignments for explicit deny permissions.
Require formal change ticket or manager approval before adding user to elevated security groups.

title: Production Database Connection Pool Exhaustion and Timeouts
keywords: database sql postgres mysql oracle connection pool timeout max connections lock deadlocks
content: Applications report database connection refused, connection timeout, or max connection limits reached. Web services encounter 500 errors due to DB backpressure.
troubleshooting_steps: Check active versus maximum allowed client connections (`pg_stat_activity` / `SHOW PROCESSLIST`).
Identify long-running idle in transaction queries and kill blocking processes if confirmed unneeded.
Inspect database server CPU, memory, and IOPS metrics on read replicas and master node.
Verify PgBouncer / ProxySQL connection pooler status and queue depth.
Review recent application deployments for missing connection close calls or sudden query volume spikes.

title: Database Replication Lag and Read Replica Failures
keywords: replication lag read replica sync wal binlog write delay secondary database
content: Read queries returning stale data or replica falling behind the primary node by several minutes or hours, impacting reporting services and read-heavy endpoints.
troubleshooting_steps: Check replication lag seconds across all active replica instances.
Inspect network throughput and disk write latency between master and affected replicas.
Determine whether large batch DDL/DML update jobs saturated the replication thread.
Temporarily redirect non-critical reporting queries to a dedicated secondary node.
If replication is broken due to corrupted WAL/binlog, schedule node re-sync from latest snapshot.

title: Application Gateway HTTP 502/503/504 Service Unavailable
keywords: api 500 502 503 504 bad gateway server down crash service unavailable outage
content: Customer-facing or internal applications returning HTTP 502 Bad Gateway, 503 Service Unavailable, or 504 Gateway Timeout errors.
troubleshooting_steps: Check container/pod restart counts and health check endpoints (/healthz, /actuator/health).
Inspect reverse proxy / load balancer upstream target group health status.
Review application error logs for unhandled NullPointerExceptions, OutOfMemory errors, or unhandled promise rejections.
Check server host CPU, RAM, and disk space (/var/log partition full).
If the degradation started immediately following a production deployment, initiate canary rollback procedure.

title: Server High CPU and Memory Exhaustion (OOM)
keywords: high cpu memory leak oom kill performance latency slow thread dump jvm
content: Compute instances or application pods experiencing persistent 90%+ CPU utilization or sudden memory exhaustion leading to Linux OOM killer termination.
troubleshooting_steps: Execute `top` / `htop` to identify the specific processes and threads consuming peak CPU.
Capture thread dumps and heap dump before restarting process to preserve memory leak diagnostics.
Examine garbage collection (GC) pause times and JVM heap utilization trends in APM (Datadog/New Relic).
Scale up horizontal replicas or increase pod resource limits temporarily to stabilize production traffic.
Engage software development team with thread dump analysis to identify infinite loops or leaky caches.

title: Corporate Email Outage and Mailflow Stoppage
keywords: email outlook exchange mail mailflow smtp mx queuing message delivery deferred
content: Organization-wide or multi-user email failure where incoming or outgoing emails are stuck in mail queues, delayed by hours, or Outlook client displays disconnected status.
troubleshooting_steps: Check Microsoft 365 / Google Workspace public service health dashboards for active tenant advisories.
Verify inbound MX record resolution and edge spam filter (e.g. Proofpoint/Mimecast) queue depth.
Review SMTP delivery retry queues and bounce notifications (NDR codes 451, 550).
Check TLS certificate validity on email delivery connectors.
If inbound delivery is completely halted, activate backup MX spooling and post status update to internal comms.

title: Outlook Client Profile Corruption and Search Failure
keywords: outlook ost pst profile indexing search crash freeze email client
content: Individual user reports Microsoft Outlook freezing on startup, corrupt OST data file, search index failing to locate recent emails, or calendar synchronization errors.
troubleshooting_steps: Verify whether the issue reproduces on Outlook Web App (OWA); if OWA works, issue is strictly local client.
Launch Outlook in Safe Mode (`outlook.exe /safe`) to isolate faulty COM add-ins.
Rebuild the Windows Search indexing service catalog for Microsoft Outlook.
Rename or delete the local cached `.ost` file and allow Outlook to recreate mail cache from Exchange server.
Create a fresh Outlook mail profile via Mail control panel if corruption persists.

title: Enterprise Software Deployment and License Activation
keywords: software install install failed license activation key sccm intune packaging
content: Requests or incidents regarding failed automated software deployment through Intune/SCCM, missing license seats, or application installation crashes on managed endpoints.
troubleshooting_steps: Confirm software name, requested version, and verify approval in Corporate Software Catalog.
Check software license seat availability in the vendor portal or internal licensing server.
Review local endpoint installation log files (`%TEMP%` or `C:\ProgramData\Microsoft\IntuneManagementExtension\Logs`).
Verify endpoint disk space, pending reboot status, and prerequisites (.NET Framework, C++ Redistributable).
Trigger manual Intune sync on endpoint and push deployment via Company Portal.

title: Phishing Incident Response and Credential Compromise
keywords: phishing malicious email suspicious link credentials compromised compromised account soc
content: Employee clicked a suspicious link, submitted credentials to a spoofed login page, or received urgent spear-phishing request with malicious attachment.
troubleshooting_steps: Immediately revoke all active refresh tokens and sessions for the affected user account via IdP console.
Reset user domain password and require MFA re-enrollment.
Isolate the user's workstation from the network via EDR (CrowdStrike/Defender) if suspicious executable ran.
Search message trace to identify all other recipients of the phishing email and purge messages from mailboxes.
Inspect sign-in logs for abnormal geographic locations or impossible travel anomalies within the last 24 hours.

title: EDR Malware Alert and Endpoint Containment
keywords: malware ransomware virus edr trojan quarantine suspicious process alert soc
content: Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) agent triggers a critical severity alert for suspicious behavioral execution, memory injection, or potential ransomware encryption.
troubleshooting_steps: Confirm endpoint containment status in EDR console to prevent lateral movement across subnet.
Examine process tree, command line execution arguments, parent process, and file hash (SHA256).
Query VirusTotal and threat intelligence feeds for malicious file hash reputation.
Identify persistence mechanisms (scheduled tasks, registry run keys, services created).
Engage Tier 2 SOC Analyst, preserve volatile forensic memory artifacts, and prepare re-imaging if necessary.

title: Major Incident Triage and Executive Escalation Guidelines
keywords: major incident p1 critical escalation war room bridge incident manager executive impact sla
content: Standard operating procedure for declaring, orchestrating, and escalating P1 Critical and P2 High major incidents affecting mission-critical business services or large user populations.
troubleshooting_steps: Confirm incident severity meets P1/P2 criteria (High Impact + High/Medium Urgency, or 100+ users affected).
Open dedicated Major Incident War Room bridge (Teams/Zoom) and post initial broadcast to IT Status Page.
Assign roles immediately: Incident Commander, Technical Lead, Scribe, and Communications Lead.
Establish 30-minute cadence for stakeholder status updates and track timeline of events.
Initiate post-incident review (PIR / Root Cause Analysis) within 24 hours of service restoration.

title: Internal Communication and Collaboration Tool Degradation
keywords: slack teams zoom collaboration chat video calls channels outage down messages
content: Company-wide or departmental issues with internal instant messaging, audio/video calls, or meeting creation on corporate collaboration platforms.
troubleshooting_steps: Check vendor status dashboards (Slack Status, Microsoft 365 Admin Portal, Zoom Status).
Determine if issue affects desktop app, web app, or mobile app equally.
Test firewall and proxy rules for required WebSocket and WebRTC UDP media port ranges (3478-3481).
Post temporary communication notice on secondary channel (Email / SMS broadcast) directing staff to backup tool.
Monitor vendor resolution advisories and confirm service recovery before closing incident.
